Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You walk the empty scene until its scattered traces become a sequence of human choices.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Time
One hour per attempt.
Target / range / shape
An accessible evidence set; one hour
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Examine an accessible evidence set. The DA names the question and sets a cumulative progress target before a consequential reconstruction; obvious deductions need no roll. On completion, obtain an evidence-supported sequence answering that question as far as the surviving evidence allows. Identify the limits of that account explicitly. Share it with companions; they need no duplicate interpretation rolls for the same facts.

Weak
1 progress and one supported fact relevant to the sequence.
Standard
2 progress, that fact, and one gap or contradiction requiring investigation.
Strong
3 progress and both findings; identify a specific place, object or person the evidence points toward for resolving the gap, if one exists.

Source: design/cards/reconstruct-the-event.md at 9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3.
